effects.name: Empowering Venom
effects.text: Use: Take a small sip of venom, gaining 513 of a random secondary stat for 15 sec. Afterwards, a random secondary stat is reduced by 73 for 15 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Coiled Fangstone
effects.text: Use: Unleash 3 Envenomed Bites centered on your target, inflicting a total of 75,107 Nature damage split between nearby enemies. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%. (1 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Knot of Writhing Serpents
effects.text: Equip: Your harmful spells have a chance to ensorcell a serpent into spewing venom at your target, inflicting 5,351 Nature damage split between nearby enemies. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%. The primary target also suffers an additional 5,351 Nature damage over 15 sec.

effects.name: Tattered Amani War Banner
effects.text: Use: Plant the banner for 15 sec! Fighting within 12 yards of it fills you with Battle Fervor, granting 305 of your highest secondary stat. Defeating at least 1 enemy while the banner stands will extend Banner's duration by 5 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Polished Lightwood Channeler
effects.text: Equip: Your damaging spells have a chance to launch a mote of light towards your target, inflicting 135 Holy damage split among nearby enemies. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%.

effects.name: Sharpened Lightwood Slasher
effects.text: Equip: Your damaging attacks and abilities have a chance to sear your target for 1,452 Holy damage.

effects.name: Binding Flame
effects.text: Use: Form a Fel Shield for 10 sec, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 1,906. While the shield holds, a portion of the absorbed damage is stored as volatile Fel energy. When the shield expires or breaks, the energy erupts and inflicts Fire damage to split between nearby enemies. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Freightrunner's Flask
effects.text: Use: Take a sip of the drink you swiped from the freight, increasing your Critical Strike by 48 for 15 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Xathuux's Last Roar
effects.text: Equip: Your damaging abilities have a chance to echo with Xathuux's furious roar, increasing your Critical Strike by 13 for 30 sec. During this time, each of your attacks increases your Critical Strike by an additional 1, stacking up to a maximum of 5 times.

effects.name: Unstable Felheart Crystal
effects.text: Use: Unleash the fel energy stored within the crystal, sacrificing 128 of your health to infuse a target ally for 10 sec, absorbing 4,473 damage. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Mycolic Medicine
effects.text: Equip: You gain Nalorakk's Favor of Growth. Your healing spells and abilities have a chance to instantly heal your target for 584 and spawn a glowing mushroom near them that lasts for 10 sec. If an ally steps on and consumes the mushroom, they are healed for an additional 334.

effects.name: Permafrost Reservoir
effects.text: Equip: You gain Nalorakk's Favor of Enduring. Taking damage has a chance to grant a Mark of Frost, increasing your Critical Strike by 6 for 15 sec. Stacks up to 10 times. If your health falls below 25%, the reservoir ruptures, consuming all marks to form a Frost Barrier that absorbs 714 damage per mark for 10 sec.

effects.name: Nalorakk's Rage
effects.text: Equip: You have proven your worth to Nalorakk. Your abilities have a chance to echo with the war god's furious roar, granting you 19 Strength for 15 sec. Nearby allies with Nalorakk's favor are rallied, gaining 25% movement speed for 10 sec.

effects.name: Seed of Radiant Hope
effects.text: Use: Surround your target ally with Lightblossoms, healing them for 1,524 over 12 sec. If their health falls below 50%, the Lightblossoms fully bloom in radiant light, instantly healing them for 1,715. (1 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Seed of the Devouring Wild
effects.text: Use: Awaken the Bloodthorn Roots, erupting around your target and inflicting 492 Nature damage split among nearby enemies. You absorb their essence, gaining 28 Mastery for 10 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Lightspire Core
effects.text: Equip: You are embraced by the Light, increasing Mastery by 8. Your damaging spells and abilities can call a beam of radiant light nearby. Standing in the light blesses you with 14 Mastery while you stand in it.

effects.name: Sapling of the Dawnroot
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to uproot a Lightspawn Lasher to aid you in combat for 15 sec, dealing up to 374 Physical damage. The Lightspawn Lasher then withers, bursting into light-infused sap and inflicting 97 Holy damage split among nearby enemies.

effects.name: Void Execution Mandate
effects.text: Use: Mark your target for execution, increasing your Haste by 24 for 20 sec. While the target is marked, each of your attacks against them grants an additional 1 Critical Strike, as the Void urges you to finish the kill, up to a maximum of 26 Critical Strike. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Crawling Plague
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks have a chance to release toxic parasites that burst around you, dealing 173 Nature damage split among nearby enemies and healing you for 132.

effects.name: Mindpiercer's Sigil
effects.text: Equip: Your damaging spells have a chance to stir the Void near your target, erupting for 447 Shadow damage split among nearby enemies. You siphon energy from the Void, gaining 21 Intellect for 10 sec.

effects.name: Ruby Whelp Shell
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to call a Ruby Whelpling, which will try to be helpful and assist you in combat.

effects.name: Ruby Whelp Shell
effects.text: Use: Call your Ruby Whelpling to inspect your target's situation, teaching them how to be helpful. (1 Day Cooldown)

effects.name: Bound by Fire and Blaze
effects.text: Use: Bind with the blaze for 20 sec, giving your attacks a high chance to increase your Strength by 8, stacking up to 6 times. When your binding is complete, emit a burnout wave, dealing up to 2,395 Fire damage split between all nearby enemies, based on the strength of your binding. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Kyrakka's Searing Embers
effects.text: Equip: Your helpful spells and abilities have a high chance to create a Burning Ember on an ally. The ember flares up after 1 sec, cauterizing wounds to heal for 1,244 and expelling 329 Fire damage split between nearby enemies.

effects.name: Golden Luster
effects.text: Use: Your movements shimmer with golden plumage, increasing your Versatility by 39 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Ritual Wraps
effects.text: Use: Wrap yourself in ritual bandages, absorbing 803 damage for 6 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Restlessness
effects.text: Equip: Standing still for 4 sec increases your Speed by 5. Lasts for 4 sec once you start moving.

effects.name: Cut of Death
effects.text: Equip: Your melee attacks have a chance to make the enemy bleed for 206 Physical damage over 12 sec. You are healed for 77 when an enemy dies while bleeding from Geti'ikku.

effects.name: The King's Unyielding Wind
effects.text: Use: Channel for 2 sec as the wind answers Dazar's command, increasing your Haste by 128 up to 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Noxious Venom Gland
effects.text: Use: Pump the fang's noxious venom gland, spraying poisonous mist forward in a cone. The mist deals 37 Nature damage every 0.9 sec over 2.7 sec, stacking up to 3 times. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Tiny Elemental in a Jar
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks and abilities have a chance to grant Phenomenal Power. On reaching 12 applications you will Unleash Lightning, inflicting 152 Nature damage.

effects.name: Curse of the Wound
effects.text: Use: Curse the target with a Rotten Wound, dealing 478 Nature damage over 15 sec. While the wound persists, your damaging spells have a high chance to deepen the wound, inflicting an additional 30 Nature damage. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Soulcoiler Ritual Vessel
effects.text: Use: Call forth 5 Soulcoiler Cultist spirits over 2 sec and sacrifice their essence, each granting an ally a barrier reducing damage taken by 50% for 20 sec or until 50,215 damage has been prevented. Allied deaths reduce this cooldown by 30 sec and immediately summon a Soulcoil Cultist spirit for sacrifice. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Ward of the Uncoiled
effects.text: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

effects.name: Keeper's Seething Core
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to grant you Focus of Ula'tek, increasing your Haste by 67 for 12 sec. Multiple applications may overlap. When two or more applications are active, your focus sharpens further to increase the effect by 20%.

effects.name: Gebbo's Bottomless Bag
effects.text: Equip: You have a chance to pull an artifact of questionable value out of the bag when casting spells and abilities, enhancing your secondary stats in various ways. There are probably no fish left in the bag, but it's hard to be sure.

effects.name: First Mate's Shellward
effects.text: Use: Deploy the Shellward to absorb up to 40% of incoming damage until 121,947 damage has been prevented for up to 30 sec. The Shellward hardens while you are below 40% health, reducing damage by 80% instead. Deal 6,067 Physical damage to melee attackers while the Shellward holds. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Ward of the Uncoiled
effects.text: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

effects.name: Vashnik's Sanguine Rancor
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks have a very high chance to build sanguine rancor within you. After 15 times, the rancor erupts to scourge your target and all nearby enemies with crimson bile, dealing 25,688 Shadow damage split between them. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%. If only one enemy is struck, the concentrated bile deals an additional 6,422 Shadow damage over 3 sec.

effects.name: Fang of Umbral Malignance
effects.text: Equip: Your harmful spells have a very high chance to befoul your target with Umbral Malignance, dealing 67 Shadow damage every 3 sec for 1 min, stacking up to 30 times. Umbral Malignance bursts upon the target's death, dealing 300% of its remaining damage split between nearby enemies and applying Umbral Malignance.

effects.name: Sszorak's Ferocity
effects.text: Equip: You have a high chance to follow up your attacks with Ravage, Mutilate, or Tempest based on the number of nearby enemies. Your killer instincts are honed, triggering this effect on your next attack upon defeating an enemy. May only occur once per 10 sec.

effects.name: Idol of the Howling Nexus
effects.text: Equip: Dodging, parrying, or blocking has a high chance to call bolstering winds, increasing your Strength or Agility by 187 and Speed by 75 for 12 sec. If you have not dodged, parried, or blocked for 15 sec, this effect is triggered immediately. May only occur once per 1 min.

effects.name: Ward of the Uncoiled
effects.text: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

effects.name: Preternatural Antivenom
effects.text: Equip: Your healing has a high chance to infuse the target with Preternatural Antivenom for 30 sec, healing your ally for 75% of any damage they take until 100,247 health has been restored.

effects.name: Vexhul's Everflowing Gland
effects.text: Use: Unleash a deluge of caustic venom, dealing 73,147 Nature damage to your target. Damage increased by 1% for every 1% health the enemy has remaining. Defeat enemies to catalyze their essential fluids into additional venom, reducing this cooldown by 5 sec. (3 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Ward of the Uncoiled
effects.text: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

effects.name: Venomfang
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to apply Venomfang, dealing 1,328 Nature damage over 6 sec before bursting to deal 581 Nature damage to nearby enemies. Multiple applications may overlap.

effects.name: Guillotine
effects.text: Equip: You have a chance to follow up your attacks with Guillotine, hurling a massive axe in an arc at your target to deal 11,142 Physical damage. Damage increased by 2% for every 1% health the target is missing.

effects.name: Hex Lord's Dooming Idol
effects.text: Equip: Your spells afflict you with Hex Lord's Doom, draining your Intellect by 1 up to 30 times. This effect may occur once every 6 sec.

effects.name: Hex Lord's Doom
effects.text: Use: Consume the power of Hex Lord's Doom, increasing your Intellect by 12 per stack for 30 sec. (30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Venomfang
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to apply Venomfang, dealing 1,328 Nature damage over 6 sec before bursting to deal 581 Nature damage to nearby enemies. Multiple applications may overlap.

effects.name: Venomcursed Haste
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Haste by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Venomcursed Mastery
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Mastery by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Font of Venomous Rage
effects.text: Use: Channel a torrent of venomous rage over 2 sec, dealing 382,672 Nature damage to your target and splattering all nearby enemies for 67,344 Nature damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. (4 Min Cooldown)

effects.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
effects.text: Use: Bite the heart and embrace the ravening hunger, gaining 149 Strength or Agility for 20 sec. While the hunger persists, gain a very high chance to devour a morsel of your target with every attack, dealing 3,525 Physical damage and further increasing your Strength or Agility by 16. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

effects.name: Venomcursed Critical Strike
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Critical Strike by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Ward of the Uncoiled
effects.text: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

effects.name: Venomcursed Ascendance
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase a random secondary stat by 152 but reduce your other secondary stats by 25 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Venomcursed Mastery
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Mastery by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Venomcursed Haste
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Haste by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Venomcursed Mastery
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Mastery by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Venomcursed Critical Strike
effects.text: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Critical Strike by 193 but reduce your other secondary stats by 32 for 12 sec.

effects.name: Zatha'tek, Breath of Corruption
effects.text: Equip: Your attacks have a chance to inflict Breath of Corruption, dealing 3,671 Nature damage and rending a Necrotic Tear that persists until death and increases the damage of this effect by 5%, up to 10 times.

effects.name: Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang
effects.text: Equip: Your spells have a chance to drain a nearby enemy's will, reducing their cast speed by 10% and increasing your Haste by 70 for 12 sec.
